replacements.original_text: The next chronology should distinguish acceptance of each condition from introduction or enactment of the amendments. A permit, site servicing, construction start, completion and occupancy would follow their own documentary trail. Readers should also retain the exact application number when searching, because an address or nearby project can lead to a different file. This discipline makes the remaining work understandable: a favorable planning decision changes permission, while the project still needs the instruments and practical arrangements that allow building to proceed.

replacements.section_heading: Read the project results within their design
replacements.original_text: ARENA's final and retrospective materials describe the project and reported results. They can support an account of the demonstrated functions and the conditions under which they were examined. They are not an independent estimate of what customer reliability would have been without the project. A reader should identify the reporting period, event or operating mode and the source of each measure. This keeps the demonstration useful while preserving the difference between a project report and a causal evaluation of broader public benefit.

replacements.original_text: The Golden-Mars material identifies an SCC decision and a route condition. It does not establish final land arrangements, completed construction or energization. That makes the connection between infrastructure planning and commercial service intelligible without merging their stages.

The records do not establish land-right completion, energization, customer eligibility or actual billing.

The September case preserves those questions as separate next steps and offers no capacity, reliability or affordability outcome for the corridor as a whole.

replacements.section_heading: A canceled project is not a complete company diagnosis
replacements.original_text: The expansion record does not establish why that project stopped, whether another expansion occurred or what happened to output and employment afterward. The report should preserve the named project and event rather than infer a company-wide decline. It should also avoid using a later capability statement to erase the earlier cancellation. The two sources can coexist in a chronology while answering different questions. That is a more faithful treatment of industrial development than assigning a broad adverse-event label from one incomplete strand.

Zero grant disbursement is not zero private investment. Neither this administrative record nor a later capability statement establishes subsequent output, employment or company-wide decline.

replacements.original_text: The inherited Golden-Mars and GS-5 case contains two concrete decisions. Virginia approved a future large-load rate class, scheduled to become effective January 1, 2027, and conditionally approved a transmission project with a local route dependency. The first concerns the terms under which a class of customers would be served. The second concerns authority for a physical transmission proposal. Their proximity does not make them one customer delivery event.

replacements.section_heading: Northern Virginia shows the institutional handoffs
replacements.replacement_text: The route order is located; the remaining questions concern its incorporated April conditions, map/CPCN compliance, land rights and any later court or appellate orders. Those matters were not fully inspected in the retained check. Construction, inspection, energization and a named service arrangement require their own records. For GS-5, the full tariff, applicable amendments and customer documents remain necessary before an eligibility or billing conclusion. Resolving one procedural question does not close the physical service or customer-acceptance gap.
replacements.reason: Replace the still-missing-final-route framing with the unverified compliance, court, land, physical-delivery and customer-specific questions.
replacements.original_text: The next useful questions therefore concern final routing, land rights, construction, inspection and energization, followed by an identifiable customer agreement. Those are distinct documents with different responsible parties. A regulatory approval can resolve an institutional dependency while leaving the physical service dependency open.

replacements.section_heading: What would strengthen the next edition

For Arizona, the decisive additions remain facility-specific utility acceptance and operating measurements. Repeated reporting should retain the same building or fab identity, measurement period, units, configuration and exception treatment so readers can distinguish a new measurement from a changed definition.

replacements.section_heading: A tariff decision is one part of the cost story
replacements.replacement_text: The SCC's November 25, 2025 announcement reports approval of Virginia's GS-5 large-load rate class with effect from January 1, 2027. That is a decision with a later announced commencement, not a measured customer bill. The separate June 29, 2026 Golden-Mars order approves Route 3A; the July 20 order declines suspension, and the docket checked September 22 lists Under Appeal. These records do not establish an appellate outcome, completed land rights, energization or a customer's connection. Full tariff and customer-specific records remain necessary for cost-allocation conclusions.
replacements.reason: Replace the inherited local-route-condition shorthand with the located decision history, retaining the affordability and customer-specific evidence limits.
replacements.original_text: Virginia's GS-5 decision gives the corpus a concrete large-load rate mechanism, scheduled for January 2027. It is more informative for cost allocation than a national demand scenario because it identifies a regulated customer category. The Golden-Mars decision separately identifies a transmission proposal and local route condition. Neither record establishes a completed customer connection in the inherited baseline.
